values: Forward generation does not ensure GNS descent: an explicit continuous counterexample. Skeide's first module-approach problem, OWR 2009 pp. 542–543; catalogue ID 30001184 / OWR-3392-012. Accepted negative counterexample to generation-only universal GNS descent for general unital C*-E0 dilations. Explicit corollary of Burgarth-Facchi-Hillier's established clock/evaluation/translated-unitary mechanism; conditional extension after kernel invariance, stronger minimality and normal W*-promotion remain unresolved here. Extensively AI-assisted; unrefereed, no independent human peer review or exhaustive first-priority claim. PR #623: https://github.com/AlecKriebel/Math/pull/623
